name: Kentucky

notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Barber and beauty services, laundry and dry cleaning, and auto repair labor: not taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Kentucky extended its sales tax to many services in 2018 and 2022-2023; the 2017 FTA answers (barber and motor vehicle repair labor exempt) are kept, not re-verified.
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Kentucky has no local general sales tax; the 6% state rate applies everywhere. (Some cities levy restaurant and transient room taxes, which are not included.)
